text: N307865December 16, 2019CLA-2-62:OT:RR:NC:N3:357CATEGORY:	ClassificationTARIFF NO.: 6210.40.2520; 6210.50.5520; 9903.88.15Jamie DeerLeedsworld, Inc.400 Hunt Valley RoadNew Kensington, PA 15068RE:	The tariff classification of men’s and women’s jackets from ChinaDear Ms. Deer:In your letter dated November 22, 2019, you requested a tariff classification. The samples will be retained for our files. Style 12938 is a men’s hip-length jacket. The garment is constructed from a laminated fabric consisting of an outer layer of 100% polyester woven fabric, a middle layer of thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) film, and an inner layer of 100% polyester knit fabric.  The plastic film is visible in cross section.The garment features a full front opening secured with a zipper closure that extends to the top of a stand-up collar; long, raglan sleeves; a snap-off hood; and a hemmed bottom.  The garment also contains zippered pockets below the waist and zippered vents under each arm.  The cuffs include hook and loop tabs, which can be used to provide tightening around the wrist.  An elastic drawcord fitted with a lock is inserted into the hem for tightening to the body.  A media pocket and a storage pocket are located on the inner front panels, and reflective details are located on the pockets, hood, shoulders, sleeves, and back, bottom of the garment. The garment’s shoulder and armhole seams are sealed.  Style 92938 is a women’s hip-length jacket.  The garment is constructed from a laminated fabric consisting of an outer layer of 100% polyester woven fabric, a middle layer of thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) film, and an inner layer of 100% polyester knit fabric.  The plastic film is visible in cross section.The garment features a full front opening secured with a zipper closure that extends to the top of a stand-up collar; long, raglan sleeves; a snap-off hood; and a hemmed bottom.  The garment also contains zippered pockets below the waist and zippered vents under each arm.  The cuffs include hook and loop tabs, which can be used to provide tightening around the wrist.   A media pocket and a storage pocket are located on the inner front panels, and reflective details are located on the pockets, hood, shoulders, sleeves, and back, bottom of the garment.  The garment’s shoulder and armhole seams are sealed.   We have examined style 12938 and have determined that it is eligible for classification as recreational performance outerwear. Per additional U.S. note 3 to chapter 62, Harmonized Schedule of the United States (HTSUS), the term “recreational performance outerwear” means trousers (including, but not limited to, ski or snowboard pants, and ski or snowboard pants intended for sale as parts of ski-suits), coveralls, bib and brace overalls, jackets (including, but not limited to, full zip jackets, ski jackets and ski jackets intended for sale as parts of ski-suits), windbreakers and similar articles (including padded, sleeveless jackets), the foregoing of fabrics of cotton, wool, hemp, bamboo, silk or manmade fibers, or a combination of such fibers; that are either water resistant within the meaning of additional U.S. note 2 to this chapter or treated with plastics, or both; with critically sealed seams, and with 5 or more of the following features (as further provided herein):insulated for cold weather protection;pockets, at least one of which has a zippered, hook and loop, or other type of closure;elastic, drawcord or other means of tightening around the waist or leg hems, including hidden leg sleeves with a means of tightening at the ankle for trousers and tightening around the waist or bottom hem for jackets;venting, not including grommet(s);articulated elbows or knees;reinforcement in one of the following areas: the elbows, shoulders, seat, knees, ankles or cuffs;weatherproof closure at the waist or front;multi-adjustable hood or adjustable collar;adjustable powder skirt, inner protective skirt or adjustable inner protective cuff at sleeve hem;construction at the arm gusset that utilizes fabric, design or patterning to allow radial arm movement; orodor control technologyStyle 12938 is included in the list of eligible apparel, is constructed from one of the named fibers, has critically sealed seams, and contains five of the following recreational performance outerwear features:Pockets, at least one of which has a zipper;Underarm vents;Weatherproof closure in the form of an exterior storm flapA drawcord tightening at the waist; andArticulated elbowsIn your letter, you provided an independent laboratory test that shows styles 12938 and 92938 are water resistant within the meaning of HTSUS, Chapter 62, Additional U. S. Note 2.  In addition, the garments are visibly impregnated, coated, covered, or laminated with plastic as described in HTSUS, Chapter 59, Additional U. S. Note 2.Note 5 to Chapter 62, HTSUS, states that garments, which are prima facie, classifiable both in heading 6210 and in other headings of this chapter, excluding heading 6209, are to be classified in heading 6210.Consequently, the applicable subheading for style 12938 will be 6210.40.2520, HTSUS, which provides for Garments, made up of fabrics of heading 5602, 5603, 5903, 5906, 5907: Other men’s or boys’ garments: Recreational performance outerwear: Of man-made fibers: Other: Anoraks (including ski-jackets), wind breakers and similar articles.  The rate of duty will be 7.1% ad valorem.The applicable subheading for style 92938 will be 6210.50.5520, HTSUS, which provides for Garments, made up of fabrics of heading 5602, 5603, 5903, 5906, 5907: Other women’s or girls’ garments: Other: Of man-made fibers: Other: Anoraks (including ski-jackets), wind breakers and similar articles.  The rate of duty will be 7.1% ad valorem.Pursuant to U.S. Note 20 to Subchapter III, Chapter 99, HTSUS, products of China classified under subheading 6210.40.2520, HTSUS, unless specifically excluded, are subject to an additional 15 percent ad valorem rate of duty.  At the time of importation, you must report the Chapter 99 subheading, i.e., 9903.88.15, in addition to subheading 6210.40.2520, HTSUS, listed above.Pursuant to U.S. Note 20 to Subchapter III, Chapter 99, HTSUS, products of China classified under subheading 6210.50.5520, HTSUS, unless specifically excluded, are subject to an additional 15 percent ad valorem rate of duty.  At the time of importation, you must report the Chapter 99 subheading, i.e., 9903.88.15, in addition to subheading 6210.50.5520, HTSUS, listed above. The HTSUS is subject to periodic amendment so you should exercise reasonable care in monitoring the status of goods covered by the Note cited above and the applicable Chapter 99 subheading.  For background information regarding the trade remedy initiated pursuant to Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974, you may refer to the relevant parts of the USTR and CBP websites, which are available at https://ustr.gov/issue-areas/enforcement/section-301-investigations/tariff-actions and https://www.cbp.gov/trade/remedies/301-certain-products-china, respectively.Duty rates are provided for your convenience and are subject to change.  The text of the most recent HTSUS and the accompanying duty rates are provided on the World Wide Web at https://hts.usitc.gov/current.This ruling is being issued under the provisions of Part 177 of the Customs Regulations (19 C.F.R. 177).A copy of the ruling or the control number indicated above should be provided with the entry documents filed at the time this merchandise is imported.  If you have any questions regarding the ruling, contact National Import Specialist Deanna Boldt via email at deanna.m.boldt@cbp.dhs.gov.Sincerely,Steven A.
